summary: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare announcing a half-year results date (26 November 2026) is a calendar-setting filing only — it contains no financial data and sets no expectation beyond confirming the reporting timeline, which is standard practice for a dual-listed NZX/ASX company.

announcements.headline: NZX Tech Investor Day Presentation
summary: VGL's NZX Tech Investor Day Presentation is a market awareness and investor relations filing — the value depends entirely on whether the presentation discloses new financial guidance, product milestones, or strategic initiatives beyond what is already in the public domain.

Not flagged market sensitive and no price action data is provided; investor day presentations at tech companies can carry meaningful signal if they include revised revenue outlooks or major contract announcements, but absent that, they function primarily as brand and awareness exercises.

Institutional investors should scan the presentation body for any new disclosure on recurring revenue metrics, customer concentration, or capital allocation priorities — these are the KPIs most likely to move a technology company's valuation on a quiet-tape filing.
